# nclip editing instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) for repository boundaries and checks.
[Documents/README.md](../../Documents/README.md) indexes canonical user and
maintainer documentation; do not duplicate configuration, routes or architecture
tables here.

This is a public fork. Never publish a developer's deployment hostnames, account
names, local paths, credentials, inspect dumps, logs or backup inventories.
Use reserved example domains and fixture data. Keep private evidence outside the
checkout and review PR bodies and Actions artifacts as well as source changes.
